comment: JWT tokens: always start with eyJ (base64url of '{"'), have two dot-separated sections. Min length prevents short false matches.
HTTP Authorization Bearer tokens. Catches non-JWT opaque tokens (GitHub ghp_, Slack xoxb-, etc.) that GENERIC-JWT won't match. Lower priority so JWT wins on overlap.
PEM private key material between BEGIN and END markers. Handles single-line log representations where newlines were stripped or replaced with spaces.
AWS IAM access key IDs (AKIA/ASIA/AROA prefix, 20 chars total). Redacting key IDs prevents targeted credential attacks even without the secret key.
